Package sys.pro

Class IncidenceGraph

java.lang.Object
sys.pro.IncidenceGraph
All Implemented Interfaces:
Graph
public class IncidenceGraph extends Object implements Graph
Implementation of a directed graph using an incidence matrix. Rows represent vertices and columns represent edges. A value of 1 means the edge leaves the vertex, -1 means it enters, and 2 represents a self-loop.
